card.statement:
We will often apply Theorem <<ref:Theorem: Loewy decomposition generic case>> in the following way.
If $V_j$, $j \in J$, are all non-isomorphic simple subquotients of $V(T(v))$, and $T(w_j) \in V_j$, then
the modules Loewy series components of $V(T(v))$ are precisely:

$$D_{i}=D_{i1}\oplus\ldots\oplus D_{i,r_{i}},$$

where $\{D_{ij}\}_{j=1}^{r_{i}}$ is the set of all $V_j$ such that $|\Omega^{+}(w_j)|=i$.
card.label: Remark 40
card.ref_key: Remark: Loewy series for generic modules

paper.title: Classification of simple Gelfand-Tsetlin modules of $\displaystyle \mathfrak{sl}(3)$
paper.abstract: We provide a classification and an explicit realization of all irreducible Gelfand-Tsetlin modules of the complex Lie algebra sl(3). The realization of these modules uses regular and derivative Gelfand-Tsetlin tableaux. In particular, we list all simple Gelfand-Tsetlin sl(3)-modules with infinite-dimensional weight spaces. Also, we express all simple Gelfand-Tsetlin sl(3)-modules as subquotionets of localized Gelfand-Tsetlin E_{21}-injective modules.
